images.title: Full boxes and marbles left
images.purpose: Give the method cue for writing a fraction greater than one as a mixed number, with the sample 17/5: full boxes of 5 give the whole part, the marbles left give the fraction part.
images.composition: Three full boxes in a row and two loose marbles set apart on the right, with two short lines of working below.
images.exact_structure: Three identical square boxes in a row, each holding exactly 5 round marbles in a neat row, marbles teal #0072B2. A small gap, then exactly 2 loose marbles of the same size, amber #E69F00, outside any box. Below, centred: the two sum lines, then the mixed number line in reddish purple #CC79A7. All marbles the same size. Exactly 3 boxes, 17 marbles.

images.takeaway: Full groups give the whole part; the units left keep the same denominator.
images.description: Seventeen marbles: 3 full teal boxes of 5 and 2 amber marbles left, worked as 3 × 5 = 15, 15 + 2 = 17 and 17/5 = 3 2/5.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the full boxes for the whole part and the loose marbles for the fraction part.

image_decisions.why: A sample of full boxes and leftovers gives a method cue for all six parts without answering any of them.
